parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of the electrical switch, made of ABS plastic. It is the external part that users press or toggle to operate the switch.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that allows the user to open or close the electrical circuit by pressing or flipping it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally around a hinge or axis to change the switch state between ON and OFF.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of polycarbonate. It houses the internal components and provides structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism, electrical contacts, and terminals in place, ensuring durability and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the switch assembly.
